title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
1

       U.S. Department of Justice
       Office of the Solicitor General



       Washington, D.C. 20530


       December 19, 2025

Honorable Scott S. Harris
Clerk
Supreme Court of the United States
Washington, D.C. 20543

 Re:   Kristi Noem, Secretary of Homeland Security, et al., Petitioners v.
Al Otro Lado, et al., S. Ct. No. 25-5

Dear Mr. Harris:

 The petition for a writ of certiorari in the above-captioned case was granted on November
17, 2025.  P etitioners’ opening brief is currently due on January 2, 2026 (day following a legal
holiday), and respondents’ opening brief is currently due on February 2, 2026 (Monday).

 On behalf of the parties on both sides, we respectfully request, under this Court’s Rule
30.4, that the time within which to file petitioners ’ brief (and the joint appendix) be extended to
and including January 6, 2026, and that the time within which to file respondents’ brief be extended
to and including February 10, 2026.  If those extensions are granted, the reply brief would be due
on March 12, 2026.

 Respondents’ counsel has authorized us to state that respondents consent to this briefing
schedule.


       Sincerely,



       D. John Sauer
       Solicitor General
